title: Name, birthplace and birth date
summary: Nellie Lutcher gives her name, Lake Charles birthplace and 1915 birth date, and says privately she is really a 1912 child.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Nellie Lutcher, I was born Nellie Rose Lutcher, and of course I married. From my second marriage my name now is Nellie Lutcher Lewis, but a very few people know about the Lewis, L-e-w-i-s.
And you were born in Lake Charles, Louisiana?
Okay. So the Encyclopedia of Jazz is correct.
It's a little bit -- well, I'm really a 1912 child, but 1915 is my professional birth date.
I'm a 1912 child. But that is not for publication.
Okay, we won't publish that at all. You sure can't tell by looking. You look wonderful.
Well, I feel marvelous, I do. I don't feel any different now than I did, oh, 25 or even 30 years ago.
